Settings

Changes are checked, saved to the board's config.json, and the display restarts to use them. Logins go to the board's auth.env and are never shown.

General

How the board's pages look.

For your name and the per-discipline pages.

Rotation

Which screens the board shows, in this order, and for how long.

#Switched-on screens play in this order, numbered. Drag a screen by its handle, or use its arrow, to move it.ScreenSecondsHow long each page shows; the line under each screen says what that means for it. Blank uses the setting it falls back on (shown greyed out). To hide a screen, switch it off.ShowOff takes the screen out of the rotation and moves it to the bottom. A screen with nothing to show yet is skipped either way.

  1. Each workout from your latest day, then a PR celebration when there is one.

    Shows: Each workout shows every stat once: 4 s each (the stat time under Timing), charts 1 s longer. A ride is about 38 s.

    Every stat

  2. Your name, then all-time totals, this week and top instructors.

    Shows: Shared by its highlights, at least 5 s each: with 3, 5 s each (15 s in all).

    s

  3. Weekly and daily streaks, one per pass.

    Shows: 4 s.

    s

  4. This week, rider against rider. Needs two or more riders.

    Shows: 4 s: all 3 stats on one page.

    s

  5. Every workout, all time. Shown as long as each Lifetime page.

    Shows: 5 s, like each Lifetime page.

    Same as Lifetime

  6. A countdown when all workouts or a discipline is a few workouts from its next milestone (a discipline's: 25, 50, 100, then every 100), closest first. How close and how many pages are under Milestones. Most days there are none.

    Shows: 4 s a countdown, up to 3.

    s

  7. All-time totals per discipline.

    Shows: 5 s a page, 4 disciplines a page.

    s

  8. Miles along the journey route.

    Shows: 4 s.

    s

  9. Minutes a day over the last 12 weeks.

    Shows: 4 s.

    s

  10. A trophy for a milestone just reached, all workouts or one discipline's, for the rest of that day. Always first, after the logo.

    Shows: 5.8 s: the trophy rises, then the number.

    s

  11. Progress toward this week's goals.

    Shows: 4 s a goal.

    s

  12. Each Peloton challenge you joined: how far to its next tier. Only running challenges with some progress and a tier still to reach.

    Shows: 4 s a challenge.

    s

  13. The next live or encore class you booked in the Peloton app: when, the class and the instructor. Only when one is booked. It takes over the whole panel just before the class starts (see Timing).

    Shows: 4 s, when a class is booked.

    s

  14. Your Club Peloton level and points, and how many points to the next level.

    Shows: 4 s.

    s

Workout insights

Comparisons with your similar earlier workouts, after your latest workout.

After the latest workout's charts, comparisons with your similar earlier workouts, such as "Output down: 124 W vs your typical 188".

Timing

How long pages last, and how often the board checks Peloton.

For any screen without its own time in Rotation.

s

How long each stat shows on a workout page.

s

The Peloton LED logo at start-up and between riders.

At start-up and between riders (once per cycle with one rider).

s

How often to look for new workouts. 300 (5 minutes) is plenty; much less only adds load.

s

The Next booked class page takes over the whole panel this many minutes before a booked class starts (either rider's), until 2 minutes after. 0 for never. Only with that screen on.

min

Goals

Weekly goals and the streak reminder.

Everyone

0 or blank for no workouts goal.

workouts

0 or blank for no minutes goal.

min

Days with at least one workout, Monday to Sunday (two on one day count once). 0 or blank for no active-days goal.

days

From this day, a week with no workout yet shows "keep your streak" instead of the streak.

Milestones

The trophy when a total is reached, and the countdown to the next one.

Total workouts

Lifetime workout counts, separated by commas. Blank for none.

Past the list, every this many workouts (100: 2,100, 2,200…). 0 for none.

workouts

Each discipline

25, 50, 100, then every 100 classes, picked automatically: 500th Strength, 600th Ride. Nothing to set.

A round number set by "Then every" or a discipline only gets the trophy if it was reached in the last 10 of those workouts, so old ones aren't celebrated.

Countdown

The Next milestone page appears when the total or a discipline is this many workouts or fewer from its next one.

to go

When more are that close, the closest ones.

pages

Schedules

Dimming at night and checking Peloton less while you sleep.

For the schedules, the week's start and today's date. Like America/New_York.

[ZONES]

Dim the panel at night.

Not set up yet: these are suggested starting values, saved only if you turn this on.

%
%

Check Peloton less often overnight.

Panel

The LED panel's size, brightness and wiring.

Columns x rows, as on the panel's label.

1 to 100. A day and night schedule, when on, takes over from it.

%

How the panel is wired to the Pi. adafruit-hat-pwm needs the Pi's onboard audio off: after choosing it, run the installer again, which offers to turn it off.

Which way up the panel is mounted.

0 to 4: higher for a faster Pi whose panel flickers.

Lower is a faster refresh; raise it if colours look wrong.

ns

Advanced

Logging, a fallback name and panel hardware. Most boards never need these.

More detail in the display's log.

Only shown if Peloton gives no username. Riders have their own in Goals.

The wrong panel settings can leave the board dark or flickering. Blank leaves each one to the default.
